text_block_list.text: "Around the middle of February, while walking in front of the station with King Halo—"

text_block_list.name: Passing High Schooler A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, look over there. Could that be...
that King girl everyone's talking about?

text_block_list.name: Passing High Schooler B
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, for real!
Is it true they'll take a photo with you if you ask?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
That entirely depends on my mood!

text_block_list.name: High Schoolers
text_block_list.text: Wah!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
My, don't look so startled.
After all the trouble King went through to speak to you.
choice_data_list: I'm so sorry about my King...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Since when did I
become your personal property?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...And so? Were you the ones who said
you 'wanted to take a photo' earlier?"

text_block_list.name: High Schoolers
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah... Yes...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Then I'll grant you the right to take a photo with me.
Please use the tags #KingIsTheBest and #TakamatsunomiyaKinen.

text_block_list.name: High Schoolers
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, of course.
The King is broad-minded and merciful, after all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho!
That made for quite a memorable photo, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Passing High Schooler A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, omg! It turned out so cute!!
Thanks for taking the photo, King!

text_block_list.name: Passing High Schooler B
text_block_list.text:
This is a thank-you from us!
Friendship chocolate for you! Here's some for you too, mister!

text_block_list.name: Passing High Schooler B
text_block_list.text:
This is a thank-you from us!
Friendship chocolate for you! Here's some for you too, miss!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Thank... you.

And swept along by the high school girls' enthusiasm,
I received some "friendship chocolate."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Friendship chocolate... Hehe.
Friendship chocolate from a fan, huh.
choice_data_list: Looks like they've taken quite a liking to you.
Looks like they've taken quite a liking to you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, isn't it obvious?
I am the King, after all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: By steadily gathering approval ratings like this—
(Splash!)

text_block_list.name: Excited Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek! I got the shot, I got it!
The headline is set! "Social Media Again? The Shameless Daily Life of a Clout-Chasing Celeb!" Perfect!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Passerby
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Is that the legendary Umamusume's daughter?
They were just talking about her on the talk shows the other day...

text_block_list.name: Woman with Child
text_block_list.text:
Ah, she's the one who became the talk of the town
after that sudden change in direction, right?

...Triggered by the paparazzi's shout,
passersby turned suspicious gazes our way.
However, King Halo—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Mr. Paparazzo.
Please hold on a moment.

text_block_list.name: Excited Paparazzo
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what is it? Like, through the Academy?
You can check it over after the article is done—...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
No, it's fine for them to scrutinize my actions.
After all, I make use of the media as well.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Using that earlier photo is completely out of the question, however.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
If this article ends up dragging in and disparaging
those girls who gave me chocolate, I will never forgive you.

text_block_list.name: Excited Paparazzo
text_block_list.text: Eep...
choice_data_list: I have something to discuss from my side as well.

text_block_list.name: Excited Paparazzo
text_block_list.text: Hyah...!?

And by the time we settled things with the paparazzi
and returned to the academy, dusk had already fallen.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer Questions Paparazzi"
"Who Was the Figure Behind the Famous Ojou-sama!?"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...'The Value of Choices Tested at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen'

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm prepared to face all sorts of opinions over what I do. But...
choice_data_list: ...Were you happy to get "friendship chocolate" from your fans?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh? T-That's...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course I was happy.
After all, it was an expression of your affection for me."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Why am I so clumsy, really?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... We're both exhausted today.
Since we were given these sweets, let's have some tea.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I shall grant you the privilege
of brewing a delicious cup of tea for King.
Come now, prepare it at once.
"And after brewing some black tea, King Halo enjoyed her chocolates with a soft smile on her face."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Of course I'm happy.
After all, it's an expression of your affection for me."
choice_data_list: Then cherish that voice above all others.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
…………
……Dummy.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll take good care of it for you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'll gratefully accept
the resolve of my number one fan.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Still, today was exhausting, wasn't it?
Since we were treated to these sweets, let's have some tea.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Today, I shall grant you the special privilege of drinking
tea brewed by my own hands. Savor every drop, won't you?"

Even while preparing the black tea,
King Halo would occasionally glance over
at her "friendship chocolates" with a gentle smile.
